reason: Publish BatikCraft Studio 0.9.17. The line tool now draws pixels instead of a vector shape object, so the eraser removes part of a line the same way it removes part of a brush stroke. Previously a line stayed a vector object that the eraser could only cover visually: moving the line afterwards left the erased hole behind in the old position. Rectangles, ellipses and polygons deliberately stay vector so their colour and stroke width remain editable. Lines in already saved projects are left as vector and keep opening exactly as they were saved. Drawing a line is committed as a single undo step.
